scenarios.title: A｜送错食物
scenarios.setting: 在“客房订单出现问题”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“送错食物”。

turns.text: Room service. How can I help you?

turns.prompt: 关于「客房订单出现问题」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, I think I received the wrong order.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I think I received the wrong order.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: Hi, the food that was delivered isn’t what I ordered.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, the food that was delivered isn’t what I ordered.
feedback.explanation: “I ordered”指出自己原先点的内容，可与实际送来的物品核对。

choices.text: I think there may have been a mix-up with my order.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think there may have been a mix-up with my order.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: You sent me the wrong food.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I think I received the wrong order.
feedback.explanation: 这句语法成立，但“you”直接归责；说明收到的餐与订单不符，更方便先核查。

choices.text: My food order is wrong one.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I think I received the wrong order.
feedback.explanation: 可说“I received the wrong order”；原句“is wrong one”缺少限定词，且没说清是收到的订单不对。

turns.text: I’m sorry about that. What did you order?

turns.prompt: 你想指出实际情况与订单或收费不一致的地方，会怎么说？

choices.text: I ordered the grilled chicken, but I received a burger.

feedback.naturalExpression: I ordered the grilled chicken, but I received a burger.
feedback.explanation: “I ordered”指出自己原先点的内容，可与实际送来的物品核对。

choices.text: I asked for pasta, not the steak.

feedback.naturalExpression: I asked for pasta, not the steak.
feedback.explanation: “I asked for”说明自己此前提出的需求，便于对方核对是否遗漏或送错。

choices.text: My order was supposed to include a chicken sandwich.

feedback.naturalExpression: My order was supposed to include a chicken sandwich.
feedback.explanation: “supposed to”表示按原计划、约定或要求应该如此，可以用来对照实际情况。

choices.text: I ordered chicken but you gave burger.

feedback.naturalExpression: I ordered the grilled chicken, but I received a burger.
feedback.explanation: “burger”是单数可数名词，需要“a burger”；用“received”描述收到的内容，也能更客观地核对。

turns.text: I apologize. We’ll send the correct dish up right away.

turns.prompt: 你想了解时间安排或需要等多久，会怎么问？

choices.text: About how long will that take?

feedback.naturalExpression: About how long will that take?
feedback.explanation: “How long”询问持续时长，而不是具体几点。

choices.text: Could you send it as soon as possible, please?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you send it as soon as possible, please?
feedback.explanation: “as soon as possible”表示尽快，说明事情紧急，但没有指定一个确定时点。

choices.text: Do you want me to keep the food that was delivered by mistake?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you want me to keep the food that was delivered by mistake?
feedback.explanation: 用于邀请或商量，先确认对方是否愿意，再决定后续安排。

choices.text: What should I do with this order?

feedback.naturalExpression: What should I do with this order?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

turns.text: We’ll have the correct order there in about fifteen minutes. You can leave the other dish with the tray.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay, thank you for fixing it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, thank you for fixing it.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Great. I’ll leave it here. Thanks.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. I’ll leave it here. Thanks.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

scenarios.title: B｜漏送东西
scenarios.setting: 在“客房订单出现问题”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“漏送东西”。

turns.prompt: 你想说明物品遗失或找不到的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, part of my order is missing.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, part of my order is missing.
feedback.explanation: “is missing”表示应有的东西缺失，便于核对订单或随身物品。

choices.text: I just received my order, but something is missing.

feedback.naturalExpression: I just received my order, but something is missing.
feedback.explanation: “is missing”表示应有的东西缺失，便于核对订单或随身物品。

choices.text: I didn’t receive everything I ordered.

feedback.naturalExpression: I didn’t receive everything I ordered.
feedback.explanation: “I ordered”指出自己原先点的内容，可与实际送来的物品核对。

choices.text: You forgot something from my order.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, part of my order is missing.
feedback.explanation: 语法没有问题，但直接认定对方忘送；“part of my order is missing”先描述结果，避免预先归责。

choices.text: My order missed something.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, part of my order is missing.
feedback.explanation: “missing”表示缺少；“my order missed something”像是订单自己漏看了东西。

turns.text: I’m sorry. What are you missing?

turns.prompt: 你想指出实际情况与订单或收费不一致的地方，会怎么说？

choices.text: I ordered a side salad, but it wasn’t included.

feedback.naturalExpression: I ordered a side salad, but it wasn’t included.
feedback.explanation: 核实某项内容是否包含在内，能避免双方对配料、配件或费用作不同假设。

choices.text: The fries are missing.

feedback.naturalExpression: The fries are missing.
feedback.explanation: “are missing”表示应有的东西缺失，便于核对订单或随身物品。

choices.text: I didn’t receive the drink I ordered.

feedback.naturalExpression: I didn’t receive the drink I ordered.
feedback.explanation: “I ordered”指出自己原先点的内容，可与实际送来的物品核对。

choices.text: I also asked for an extra set of cutlery, but it isn’t here.

feedback.naturalExpression: I also asked for an extra set of cutlery, but it isn’t here.
feedback.explanation: “cutlery”指刀叉勺等餐具的统称，通常不可数。

turns.text: I apologize. I’ll have that sent up immediately.

turns.prompt: 你想确认漏送的餐品会如何补送，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thank you. Could you make sure the drink is included this time?

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. Could you make sure the drink is included this time?
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。

choices.text: Great. About how long will it take?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. About how long will it take?
feedback.explanation: “How long”询问持续时长，而不是具体几点。

choices.text: Thanks. I’m in room 806.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I’m in room 806.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

scenarios.title: C｜迟迟没有送到
scenarios.setting: 在“客房订单出现问题”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“迟迟没有送到”。

turns.text: Room service. How may I help you?

turns.prompt: 关于「客房订单出现问题」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, I placed an order about an hour ago, but it hasn’t arrived yet.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I placed an order about an hour ago, but it hasn’t arrived yet.
feedback.explanation: “hasn’t arrived”表示直到现在仍未到达，强调当前尚未收到。

choices.text: I’m calling about a room service order that hasn’t been delivered.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m calling about a room service order that hasn’t been delivered.
feedback.explanation: 开头就交代来访或来电目的，帮助对方判断该查询什么、由谁处理。

choices.text: I’ve been waiting for my order for almost an hour.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve been waiting for my order for almost an hour.
feedback.explanation: “I’ve been”把过去的经历或持续情况与现在联系起来，适合交代背景。

choices.text: My food still hasn’t arrived.

feedback.naturalExpression: My food still hasn’t arrived.
feedback.explanation: “hasn’t arrived”表示直到现在仍未到达，强调当前尚未收到。

choices.text: I ordered one hour before but no food come.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I placed an order about an hour ago, but it hasn’t arrived yet.
feedback.explanation: 相对现在的一小时前用“an hour ago”；尚未送到可说“hasn’t arrived yet”，让两个时间关系更清楚。

turns.text: I’m sorry about the delay. May I have your room number?

turns.prompt: 告诉对方你的房间号，方便对方处理，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’m in room 806.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m in room 806.
feedback.explanation: 直接报出房间号，便于前台定位住客、送物或查询记录；无需再重复整个来意。

choices.text: Room 806. I ordered at around seven o’clock.

feedback.naturalExpression: Room 806. I ordered at around seven o’clock.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: It’s room 806. Could you check the status of the order?

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s room 806. Could you check the status of the order?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

turns.text: Let me check… Your order is on the way now.

turns.prompt: 你想了解还需要多少时间，会怎么问？

choices.text: Do you know how much longer it will take?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you know how much longer it will take?
feedback.explanation: “How much longer”问还要多久，关注从现在起剩余的等待时间。

choices.text: Could you tell me when I should expect it?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you tell me when I should expect it?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Is it likely to arrive within the next ten minutes?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is it likely to arrive within the next ten minutes?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: I’ve already waited quite a while.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Do you know how much longer it will take?
feedback.explanation: 这句能表达已等很久，但没有直接询问后续；若需要具体信息，可接着问还要多久。

turns.text: It should be there within ten minutes. We apologize for the delay.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay, thank you for checking.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, thank you for checking.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: All right. I’ll wait another ten minutes.

feedback.naturalExpression: All right. I’ll wait another ten minutes.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Thanks. I’d appreciate it if it could arrive soon.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I’d appreciate it if it could arrive soon.
feedback.explanation: “I’d appreciate”将希望对方做的事与感谢联系起来，语气比直接命令更委婉。

scenarios.title: D｜修改 / 取消订单
scenarios.setting: 在“客房订单出现问题”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“修改 / 取消订单”。

turns.text: Room service. How can I help you?

turns.prompt: 关于「客房订单出现问题」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: Hi, I just placed an order, but I’d like to make a change.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I just placed an order, but I’d like to make a change.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: I’d like to change something in my room service order.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to change something in my room service order.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: I need to modify an order I just placed.

feedback.naturalExpression: I need to modify an order I just placed.
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: I want to change my food order.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I just placed an order, but I’d like to make a change.
feedback.explanation: 这句语法正确；提到“just placed an order”能让工作人员知道要改的是刚下的订单，而非新点单。

choices.text: I want modify my order.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I just placed an order, but I’d like to make a change.
feedback.explanation: “want”后接动作时需要“to + 动词原形”；提出服务需求也可以用“I’d like to …”，既补全结构，也更委婉。

turns.text: Certainly. What would you like to change?

turns.prompt: 你想说明自己想调整订单中的哪些内容，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could I change the fries to a side salad?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could I change the fries to a side salad?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

choices.text: I’d like to remove the dessert from the order.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to remove the dessert from the order.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: Could I add another drink, please?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could I add another drink, please?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

choices.text: I’d actually like to cancel the entire order.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d actually like to cancel the entire order.
feedback.explanation: “entire order”指整份订单；取消时说明范围，避免被理解成只取消其中一项。

turns.text: Let me check whether the kitchen has started preparing it.

turns.prompt: 你想处理取消事宜，会怎样说明需求？

choices.text: Sure. If they haven’t started yet, I’d like to cancel it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. If they haven’t started yet, I’d like to cancel it.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: Okay. Please let me know if it’s still possible to make the change.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Please let me know if it’s still possible to make the change.
feedback.explanation: “Let me …”提出由自己来做下一步，能明确谁来采取行动。

choices.text: If it’s too late to change it, that’s okay.

feedback.naturalExpression: If it’s too late to change it, that’s okay.
feedback.explanation: 用简短回应表示不介意或愿意体谅，可以减轻对方的歉意。

turns.text: They haven’t started yet, so we can make that change.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Perfect. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Great. Please go ahead with the change.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Please go ahead with the change.
feedback.explanation: “go ahead”表示请继续或可以开始，让对方知道自己准备好了。

choices.text: Thanks for checking.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks for checking.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。
